help.howitworks.switching_service_source.backTranslation: Why the choices change: permanently failed sources; services that are turned off, unavailable, out of quota or not in your plan; or completed downloads all disappear from the list or are shown as unavailable. Merely switching back and forth does not by itself remove any choice.

Progress: if choosing a source would discard progress already made, DebridPulse first asks Discard downloaded progress?. A service switch that would discard progress is refused outright, with the reason Downloaded data would be discarded; switch its source to confirm.

While a download is paused: when you choose another source for a file that has already started downloading, the choice is accepted and saved, but no work starts. The service and source shown remain the current ones, and next to the service name a message indicates where the file will move, for example Switching to Real-Debrid (rapidgator.net) on resume. Choosing again replaces that message; choosing the source currently in use removes it. After resuming, the message shows Switching to… until the switch takes effect and then disappears. If paused files in the same download would move to different places, or the destination is unknown, no destination is shown. A file that never started has nothing to hand over, so its new source is simply applied when it starts. Choosing a Service while paused works as described above, but the download stays paused: a service that can take over the link currently in use takes over immediately (the badge shows that service), and a service that must first prepare a copy shows Preparing… and takes over only after you resume. These messages appear on the rows of Download Activity and Downloads; both messages may appear at the same time.

help.howitworks.backup_torrents.each_deb.backTranslation: Each debrid service has a Prepare backup torrents switch. It is on by default for AllDebrid, Debrid-Link, Premiumize and Real-Debrid; TorBox has stricter torrent limits, so it is off by default. When on, the service also adds torrents that other services are delivering, so it can take over if needed; when you switch a download to another service, the torrent that had already started is kept as a backup instead of being removed. This uses that account's torrent slots and limits; new downloads that need a slot reclaim it first. Turning this switch off keeps the service's slots for its own downloads: its backup torrents are then removed. Your previously saved choice is kept.

help.howitworks.backup_torrents.debrid_s.backTranslation: A debrid service can also add a torrent that another service is delivering, so that it can take over when needed; when a download switches to another service, the torrent that had already started can be kept as a backup instead of being removed. This is each service's Prepare backup torrents setting: on by default for AllDebrid, Debrid-Link, Premiumize and Real-Debrid, off by default for TorBox; it is in that service's More settings, in the Advanced presentation. Backup torrents use the account's torrent slots and limits; a new download that needs a slot reclaims the slot first.

help.howitworks.pause_resume_retry.retry.backTranslation: Retry (or Reset) restarts a failed download from its original source, without having to add it again. Used on a completed or removed download, it downloads those files again.

help.howitworks.pause_resume_retry.remov.backTranslation: Remove removes the download from the list. DebridPulse also cleans up the copy it created on the service, and any unfinished partial files it was writing. Files that have finished downloading stay in your folder.

help.howitworks.pause_resume_retry.admin.backTranslation: Administrators can remove or cancel any download or switch its source. Users can do so only when no other account still needs that download (including downloads merged into it); otherwise, users can only withdraw their own request in Requesters, and the download continues for the others.

help.howitworks.adding_same_thing.if_add.backTranslation: If the magnet link, {file_type}, NZB or Metalink file you add is something DebridPulse is already handling (including items that failed but have not been removed), Already in queue is shown and the existing download is kept, instead of a second download being started. Web links are always added as new downloads. After a download is completed, cancelled or removed, adding the same source again starts a new download. If two downloads are actually fetching the same content, DebridPulse may merge them; the merged download shows Merged. If DebridPulse cannot prove the two match, the merged download instead shows Merged · Unverified. Merging does not change who made the request: each account's requests remain separate.

help.howitworks.passwords_private_links..backTranslation: A username and password written in a link ({link}) are used directly for that download without asking again, including for every file in a folder, and are removed from the link before it is saved. They are kept in memory only for that download, and are forgotten when the download completes, is cancelled or removed, after at most 24 hours, or when DebridPulse restarts.

help.settings.downloads.download_behavio.backTranslation: Download behavior and limits: Download folder (Browse can be used) and Maximum simultaneous downloads. Even when allowed, DebridPulse will never connect to the computer it runs on or to other non-private local addresses. Also there: Provider polling interval (how often to check the progress of jobs a service is preparing), Full sync interval (how often downloads are reconciled against each enabled paid account that lists its transfers; 0 turns it off), and Resolution failure retries and Retry delay (minutes) (how many times a failed resolution is retried and how long until it is retried, applying to any service, including network sources).

help.settings.access_integrations.integr.backTranslation: Integration accounts are for automation and cannot sign in to these pages. Issue token shows the new token only once; copy it right away. Tools send it as {literal}. Each token can see only the jobs submitted through it. Revoke disables the token immediately and does not affect anything it has already submitted.

Integration delivery profiles tell an external application (such as Sonarr or Radarr) which Categories it can submit to, which kinds of sources it can send (Source types), which of its tokens can use this profile (Authorized API tokens), and where to find completed files (DP download path is in DebridPulse's download folder, and External import path is the location of this folder as that application sees it). Files are shared in place: no file is copied, moved or deleted for that application. Until the profile has one category, one source type and one valid authorized API token, the download client interface remains unavailable.

help.settings.users_access.user.backTranslation: User: can add downloads, and can pause, resume, retry and reorder downloads; can see all transfers; can remove, cancel or switch a download only when no other account still needs it, otherwise only withdraws their own request. Has their own Notifications page; cannot use Settings.

help.settings.users_access.user_accounts.backTranslation: User accounts lists each person's role, sign-in method, and whether the account is enabled. Add local account creates an account that uses a username and password. A role changed in Edit user takes effect immediately: pages that user has open reload with the new role, without signing them out. Everyone has a DebridPulse username, separate from their display name: OIDC accounts get a username on first sign-in, and it is also the name used for local password sign-in; the pencil icon next to the name in the Edit user title changes it and keeps any saved password. Click an account's name to see its details and activity, where outstanding requests can also be withdrawn individually. Disable and Remove first show how many outstanding download requests the account has; these requests are withdrawn, transfers that others also requested continue, and completed downloads are never affected. Disabling also ends the account's sign-in sessions and disables its tokens; removing keeps the account's history and deletes its own notification settings. A removed OIDC sign-in that appears again gets a new account, and that account stays disabled until you enable it. Merge combines two or more accounts into the account you choose to keep; two accounts sharing the same verified email are flagged, but only "Merge" combines them. DebridPulse always keeps at least one usable administrator, and you cannot change your own role or disable your own account.

During the reset, running downloads are stopped and processing is paused; afterwards the previous pause state is restored. Completed files already in the download folder are not deleted.

help.trouble.i_cannot_sign.last_resort_i.backTranslation: Last resort (if no sign-in method works): this requires access to the computer running DebridPulse, and it temporarily removes all protection, so do it only on a trusted network. Stop DebridPulse, and back up its configuration file (usually {path} inside the container). In that file set {literal_1} and {literal_2} to {literal_3}, and make sure the file is still valid JSON; DebridPulse refuses to start when the configuration file is corrupted. After DebridPulse starts, anyone who can reach it can access it, including its API. Your saved passwords and OIDC settings are kept, so repair them in Settings → Authentication and turn protection back on immediately.

help.trouble.backup_restore_reset.if_saf.backTranslation: If the safety backup fails, the reset or restore stops. Fix the Backup folder (location, permissions, free space); the safety backup cannot be skipped.

help.trouble.backup_restore_reset.if_res.backTranslation: If a restore can neither complete nor be undone (for example, the disk stops accepting changes partway through), DebridPulse stops using its stored data: every page and request responds that a restart is required, and its health check reports an unhealthy status. Your previous database and settings are kept. After the disk becomes writable again, restart the DebridPulse container yourself; on startup it restores the previous state. Docker will not restart it automatically because of a failed health check.

findings.note: Translator: 'undone' = 撤銷 (as in error.backup.detail.unresolved) to keep it distinct from 復原 (Recovery); 'puts the previous state back' = 恢復, not 還原 (backup restore).
findings.resolution: The translator chose the wording recorded in the note.

help.quickstart.follow_finish.download_a.backTranslation: The download appears in Download activity on the Dashboard, and also in Downloads. Click it to open its details: the service delivering it, its files and events. You can pause, resume and retry a download; you can remove a download only when no other account still needs it; otherwise withdraw your own request in Requesters.

help.notifications.how_saving_works.ther.backTranslation: There is no Save button. Each setting is saved individually: a typed value is saved when you leave the field, and a switch or list option is saved immediately when you change it. If a value cannot be saved, a message explains why, and the field reverts to the saved value. A saved webhook is not shown again; leave its field blank to keep it, and press Clear to remove it.

help.topic.integration_accounts.what_int.backTranslation: It cannot directly pause, delete or redirect transfers, cannot change settings, and cannot see other clients' jobs.

help.topic.delivery_profiles.jobs_files..backTranslation: Submitting a job creates a download request belonging to that application. Removing the job in the application withdraws that request, or acknowledges the delivery after delivery is complete; the transfer itself stops only when no one else needs it.
Completed files are shared in place: no files are copied, linked or moved for the application, and neither confirming delivery nor delivery expiring deletes any file.

help.topic.deployment_type.what_switchin.backTranslation: No account is deleted. Other people's accounts keep their usernames, passwords, identity provider links, and saved "Enabled" or "Disabled" state. In Standalone mode they cannot sign in, regardless of that state.

help.topic.deployment_type.what_switchin.backTranslation: Switching clears the built-in Administrator's password, turns off Username & Password and OpenID Connect sign-in, and ends all browser sessions.

Afterwards no sign-in is needed: anyone who can connect to DebridPulse through an address DebridPulse accepts can use it as the built-in Administrator. This is not limited to this computer, and it does not expire.

help.topic.backups.backups.while_enable.backTranslation: While "Enable" is on, a backup is created every "Backup interval", and "Back up now" creates one immediately. "Backups" lists the saved backups and lets you add, save, restore or remove one of them.

help.topic.database_reset.what_removed_k.backTranslation: Removed: records of transfers and their files, download requests, external jobs, events and activity records, and statistics snapshots.

help.topic.database_reset.safeguards.res.backTranslation: "Reset database" can be used only when "Allow database reset" is on, and asks you to confirm.

help.topic.database_reset.safeguards.pro.backTranslation: Processing is paused during the reset and returns to its previous state when it finishes. A safety backup is made first; if the backup fails, nothing is cleared.
